newsitem.title: USA: Clinton may get Fed recommendations on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Clinton may get Fed recommendations on Thursday.

text.p: The White House said President Bill Clinton had not yet received recommendations for nominees to fill the two vacancies on the Federal Reserve Board but added that he might get them later on Thursday.

"The recommendations have not gone to the president," White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters. Asked if Clinton might get them later in the day, he replied: "It's aimed in that direction (and) probably going to end up there soon. But then what he does with it, or whether he accepts the recommendations or wants to revisit it, is the kind of decision presidents get to make."

McCurry said Clinton would get two recommendations, one for each of the slots created by the departures of former Fed governors Laurence Lindsey and Janet Yellen, who has become chair of the president's Council of Economic Advisers.
